changeSet.author: grushton

preConditions.onFailMessage: data_access_request must have 5 timestamp or timestamptz column(s): approving_so_timestamp, create_date, institution_snapshot_date, submission_date, update_date. Compare the deployed schema with the changesets before you deploy.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'data_access_request' AND column_name IN ('approving_so_timestamp', 'create_date', 'institution_snapshot_date', 'submission_date', 'update_date') AND data_type IN ('timestamp without time zone', 'timestamp with time zone')

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE data_access_request ALTER COLUMN approving_so_timestamp TYPE timestamp with time zone, ALTER COLUMN create_date TYPE timestamp with time zone, ALTER COLUMN institution_snapshot_date TYPE timestamp with time zone, ALTER COLUMN submission_date TYPE timestamp with time zone, ALTER COLUMN update_date TYPE timestamp with time zone

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE data_access_request ALTER COLUMN approving_so_timestamp TYPE timestamp without time zone, ALTER COLUMN create_date TYPE timestamp without time zone, ALTER COLUMN institution_snapshot_date TYPE timestamp without time zone, ALTER COLUMN submission_date TYPE timestamp without time zone, ALTER COLUMN update_date TYPE timestamp without time zone
